title: Gaussian noise on multilinear polynomials
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number, let $F$ assign a real coefficient $F(S)$ to each subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $x\in\mathbb R^n$. Define $P_F(z)=\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}}F(S)\prod_{i\in S}z_i$. Then Gaussian noise of correlation $\rho$ satisfies
\[T_\rho P_F(x)=P_F(\rho x).\]
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a real coefficient family indexed by subsets of the $n$ coordinates
